summary: Runtime dependency resolved from unpinned GitHub repository
details: package.json declares the runtime dependency `libsignal` with the value `github:RahmadTenpoles/libsignal-node` — a bare GitHub reference with no commit SHA, tag, branch pin, or integrity hash. On `npm install`, this resolves to whatever the default branch HEAD of that repository contains at the moment of install, and any lifecycle scripts within that fetched source execute on the installer's machine. The resolved module is then loaded at require-time via lib/Signal/libsignal.js, so its code runs when raiden-baileys is imported as well. The owner of the referenced GitHub repository can replace the installed code at any time without any change to this package or its version number, and installers have no way to verify what bytes they received.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
